build_grpcio_tools_package: build the grpcio-tools Python package by running python setup.py install with optional Cython support
check_linker_need_libatomic: check if the system linker requires the libatomic library for C++ atomic operations
configure_extension_modules: configure the grpc_tools._protoc_compiler C++ extension module with platform-specific compiler and linker flags
copy_proto_resources: copy protobuf resource files from the include directory into the grpc_tools._proto package data directory
review_setup_py: review the grpcio-tools setup.py build configuration for platform-specific compiler flags and extension module setup
